allowed_message_insertion.recovery: For an observed INVALID_CLOSED_VIEW_BOUNDS or another rejected editable VIEW argument, criticize the actual selector/start_char/cap/reserve against the bounds above and explicitly issue a fresh valid NEXT at the SAME accepted selector and start_char, using output_cap_bytes 8192 and metadata_reserve_bytes 2048. Continue each permitted explicit VIEW and CONFIRM through both EOFs; incomplete reading or a large input alone is not a fixed-source blocker.
